Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Stuffing the paper into the cup
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image provide enough evidence to determine whether the paper has been stuffed into the cup?
node.criteria: Pass if the image clearly resolves whether the paper is inside the cup and stuffed into it. Fail if the image clearly shows it is not stuffed into the cup. Unknown if visibility or ambiguity prevents a determination; retain this as unresolved rather than inferring completion or absence.
node.binding: Use only visible evidence of the paper’s placement relative to the cup; do not treat proximity or contact with the rim alone as proof of stuffing.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image shows the paper held over the cup, with no visible portion of the paper inside it; it is not stuffed into the cup.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image shows a hand holding the paper over a cup, but the paper is not visibly inside or stuffed into it.

fulfillment: The node’s outcome is supported: the edited image shows paper held over a cup, with no visible portion inside, so “absent” is consistent with the rubric’s no-progress criterion. Preserve that distinction rather than treating proximity or an attempted placement as progress. Improve the binding’s executable clarity: the supplied node binding is truncated/ambiguous (“visibly (...) image show…”), while the fuller target and criteria specify visible insertion and distinguish absent from partial. Ensure the node uses that frozen target and combines both support observations without counting their repeated, dependent wording as independent corroboration. Keep “unknown” available when the cup interior or paper position cannot be judged; here the observations are valid and directly describe no visible insertion, so this is not a transport, schema, or dependency failure. The reference label agrees with the result but should not substitute for visual evidence.
